description: NaMg₂V₃O₁₀ crystallizes in the triclinic P̅1 space group. Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.40-2.75 Å. There are two inequivalent Mg sites. In the first Mg site, Mg is bonded to six O atoms to form MgO₆ octahedra that share corners with seven VO₄ tetrahedra and  an edgeedge with one MgO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 2.02-2.16 Å. In the second Mg site, Mg is bonded to six O atoms to form MgO₆ octahedra that share corners with six VO₄ tetrahedra and edges with two MgO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 2.02-2.18 Å. There are three inequivalent V sites. In the first V site, V is bonded to four O atoms to form VO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four MgO₆ octahedra and  a cornercorner with one VO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 45-60°. There are a spread of V-O bond distances ranging from 1.68-1.81 Å. In the second V site, V is bonded to four O atoms to form VO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three equivalent MgO₆ octahedra and corners with two VO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 35-61°. There are a spread of V-O bond distances ranging from 1.66-1.81 Å. In the third V site, V is bonded to four O atoms to form VO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with six MgO₆ octahedra and  a cornercorner with one VO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 15-64°. There are a spread of V-O bond distances ranging from 1.66-1.86 Å. There are ten inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to one Na and two V atoms. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one Mg, and one V atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a linear geometry to one Mg and one V atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to two Mg and one V atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na, one Mg, and one V atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Mg and one V atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to one Mg and two V atoms. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na, one Mg, and one V atom. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to two Mg and one V atom. In the tenth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Mg, and one V atom.
